scope: One fresh-context plan-only authoring trial; no DSH model execution, PPTX, baseline or blind human comparison

authorContext.allowedInputs: Task text, current SKILL and task-relevant references only

findings.observation: All eight original RMSE values and the unit t/ha are retained. The four within-condition differences are -0.09, +0.10, +0.05 and +0.02. No raw points, uncertainty estimates, p-values or additional experiment results are invented.

The plan explicitly says A loses its observed random-split advantage in all three provided site holdouts. It neither softens these directions to minor fluctuations nor generalizes them to every new site.
120 records, three sites and two years of data coverage are distinguished. The plan does not claim cross-year independent validation or pool site RMSEs into an unsupported overall RMSE.
A process constraint is described as a testable method idea. The plan does not claim its causal contribution, physiological validity, architecture or novelty is established.

A shared-zero difference plot is paired with an aligned table preserving all original values. Required conditions stay on the page. No decorative agricultural photos, maps or extra cards are introduced.
Four pages with no standalone cover; 80+100+190+110=480 seconds. Existing authorization is respected and no user approval or rendering outcome is fabricated.
The geometry is a proposed execution starting point. Actual layout fit, font substitution, editable output, projection legibility and spoken duration remain unverified.

disposition: No substantive source distortion identified in this plan. Proceed to actual build/render only when that workflow is run; do not treat this as visual approval.
